subject: Operational rhythm: mid-quarter steer and scope gates for OKRs
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: sarah.liu@acmecloud.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Operational rhythm: mid-quarter steer and scope gates for OKRs

Team —

We’re halfway through the quarter and I want to lock a lightweight gating process so leadership can sign off on scope trims for any initiatives that are behind plan. Attached is a one-page scope gate matrix (Q3_scope_gate_matrix_v1.xlsx) with current owner input, a red/amber/green snapshot, and my suggested carve-outs. High-level asks: 

- Please mark your OKR sub-initiatives as "must ship this quarter" vs "deferable" directly in the sheet by EOD Thu (30 Jul).
- Flag any infra dependencies (GPU time, infra hiring, security reviews) you need to keep a must-ship.
- If you require additional budget or a contract/PO (e.g., from Acme Cloud or CedarTech), note the amount and the external contact.

Rationale: we need predictable runway for Dedicated and Private rollout work. If we can confirm scope cuts now we avoid a last-minute scramble and can reallocate engineers within the org. I’ll consolidate and present a single recommended set of cuts for exec review next Monday.

Quick context in the sheet: the Product -> Serving Runtime sequence is where we’re missing velocity; a couple of medium-impact features can be deferred without customer-facing regressions.

Significant constraints to call out up front: 
- Model onboarding task for the new 70B variant requires a KV cache patch that Karthik’s team owns.
- The Dedicated autoscaler work depends on a short SOC2 evidence window (security) that may introduce a one-week hold.

I’ll group items by risk and business impact after your updates. If anyone prefers a 15-min sync instead of spreadsheet edits, put your availability into my calendar.

Thanks —
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Q3_scope_gate_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: supporting_cost_breakdown.pdf (PDF)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Operational rhythm: mid-quarter steer and scope gates for OKRs

Rafael —

Thanks for kicking this off. I updated the matrix with status for the Growth & Integrations workstream. Quick summary: 

- Integrations: two connector launches are "must ship" (Stripe rev share, Snowflake ingestion). They depend on a short block from Infra for a networking ACL change and a cert rotation; without that we cannot meet the staging cutoff.
- Usage metering/console: reclassifying the client-side cost-analytics dashboard as "deferable" to Q4 — low customer impact and we can still hit revenue targets.
- Customer pilots: Acme Cloud pilot remains a must-ship; Sarah is aligned but wants final contract language cleared by Contracts.

Karthik — can Infra prioritize the ACL and certificate work for the integrations path this week? If not, we’ll mark the connector as deferred and drop the customer pilot ask into the next readout.

Laura
Director, Growth Product
Redwood Inference

>

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Operational rhythm: mid-quarter steer and scope gates for OKRs

Laura / Rafael —

I saw Laura’s notes and updated the infra block in the matrix to indicate ETA. Short version: we can do the ACL and cert rotation but we’ll need a 48-hour maintenance window on staging and one overnight GPU cluster re-provision for the model KV cache patch. That overnight slot is the only blocker for the 70B variant onboarding.

Two asks from Infra to make this realistic:
- Confirm whether the 70B onboarding is a "must ship" — if yes, we’ll prioritize the overnight; if it’s deferable, we’ll reprioritize to other infra backlog items.
- If the Acme pilot requires dedicated networking (VPC peering + dedicated IP), we need a signed PO for Acme (estimated infra incremental run-rate ~$5k/month) so we can request the cloud links immediately. Contracts (external) are the right channel.

I can arrange the 48-hour window Fri->Sat if Leadership approves the must-ship status and the PO conversation moves quickly.

Karthik
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

On Wed, Jul 29, 2026 at 11:03 Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Rafael —
> 
> Thanks for kicking this off. I updated the matrix with status for the Growth & Integrations workstream...
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, sarah.liu@acmecloud.com, contracts@cedartech.com
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Operational rhythm: mid-quarter steer and scope gates for OKRs — recommended cuts and approvals

Vanessa / Marissa —

I consolidated team inputs and recommend the following for executive signoff next Monday:

1) Approve must-ship set: Integrations connectors (Stripe, Snowflake), Acme Cloud pilot (contract pending), and the KV cache patch for 70B onboarding. These keep our top-line momentum and customer commitments intact.

2) Defer: Client cost-analytics dashboard and two low-usage UX polish items to Q4. This frees ~4 engineer-weeks immediately.

3) Infra asks: approve one overnight GPU maintenance window and a temporary reallocation of two infra engineers for the week of Aug 9. If approved, Karthik will schedule the staging window.

4) Contracts/billing: Marissa, please proceed with expedited PO path for Acme (estimated $5k/mo infra incremental). Contracts@cedartech.com is copied — can you confirm the expected turnaround and any redline concerns?

I’ve attached the final matrix (Q3_scope_gate_matrix_v1.xlsx) and a short cost breakdown. If you’re comfortable, I’ll present this as the recommended slate to execs on Monday morning.

Thanks —
Rafael
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Q3_scope_gate_matrix_v1.xlsx (final)
Attachment: supporting_cost_breakdown.pdf
